segments.text:
V. 16.
Theſe things his diſciples underſtood not at firſt—The Deſign of GOD's providential Diſpenſations, is ſeldom underſtood at firſt. We ought therefore to believe, tho' we underſtand not, and to give ourſelves up to the Divine Diſpoſal. The great Work of Faith is, To embrace thoſe Things which we know not now, but ſhall know hereafter. When he had been glorified—At his Aſcenſion.
